description.value:
You learn Hypervelocity, Jugular Rip, Abdomen Tear, and Eye Gouge. Matching follow-ups: Burst Strike → Hypervelocity; Gnashing Fang → Jugular Rip; Savage Claw → Abdomen Tear; Wicked Talon → Eye Gouge.

After you hit with Burst Strike, Gnashing Fang, Savage Claw, or Wicked Talon, you can use its matching follow-up as a free action immediately afterward against the same creature, provided it remains within your melee reach. Any other action in between, including another free action, closes the opening. Reactions do not close it. The opening ends at the end of your turn or when consumed. Only one Continuation follow-up, including Fated Brand, can be used per round.

Each follow-up deals 1d6 fire damage, 2d6 at 12th level and 3d6 at 18th. It has no attack roll or save, does not increase MAP, and never doubles on a critical opening Strike. It is a separate damage effect for immunity, weakness, and resistance. No Mercy and weapon property-rune damage do not add to it.

Fated Brand keeps its fresh basic Reflex saves, eligible-target restrictions, and the shared Continuation limit. It is also a free action.
